# Confidential Transfers (JavaScript)

Example code for confidential transfers of Multi-Purpose Tokens (MPTs) on devnet with [xrpl.js](https://github.com/XRPLF/xrpl.js).

## Setup

```sh
npm install
```

## Issue an MPT for confidential transfers

```sh
node issueConfidentialMPT.js
```

You should see output like the following:

```sh
node sendConfidentialPayments.js
```

## Claw back a confidential balance

```sh
node clawbackConfidentialMPT.js
```
